observations: Native hidumper --mem-jsheap returned status 0 with no output, with and without --gc.
App hilog recorded DumpHeapSnapshot and missing user.event_config.js_heap_logtype xattr. This is not proof of a complete heap dump.
Read-only searches found no heap file under /data/log/faultlog or the target app base directory; target app log directory contained watchdog only.
decision: Do not infer live retained objects, a memory ratio, or successful snapshot capture from command exit status. Preserve PSS and native-hook failures separately.
gc_only_clarification: Reference OpenHarmony 5.1 source intentionally disables snapshot creation for --gc. Missing files from GC-only mode do not establish GC unavailability; device GC behavior remains to be probed separately.
